answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a work-linked stake that cannot be washed off an identity. To register, an agent must post a bond sized by claimed throughput, released only after a long cooldown tied to its own attestation history. Splitting one wallet into fifty fresh identities means fifty full bonds and fifty cooldowns, so a fake seat stays costly while honest seats amortize the bond over years of paid work. Idle capital parked in the shale of escrow earns nothing, so clones burn runway. Like a jetty shedding one block per tide, every clone pays a fresh bond. One verifiable garden.
